Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Elegant Events Chapel specializes in providing comprehensive wedding services, including ceremony officiation, venue rental, and event planning. Our offerings primarily focus on creating memorable experiences for couples, with a strong emphasis on personalized service. We ensure that sales from our ancillary services, such as decorations and floral arrangements, do not exceed 30% of our gross revenue. Additionally, while we provide light background music options, we strictly limit any entertainment to avoid surpassing our underwriting guidelines. Our venue is designed to accommodate small to medium-sized weddings, prioritizing intimacy and elegance.
